gloss: virtue; merit; good point; strong point

definitions.gloss: virtue; merit; good point; strong point
definitions.explanation: A positive quality or admirable aspect of a person, thing, or situation. More literary and formal than {長所|ちょうしょ}.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{美点|びてん}は{誠実|せいじつ}さだ。
この{作品|さくひん}の{美点|びてん}を{見落|みお}としてはいけない。
examples.english: You must not overlook the merits of this work.

examples.japanese: {欠点|けってん}ばかり{指摘|してき}するのではなく、{相手|あいて}の{美点|びてん}にも{目|め}を{向|む}けるべきだ。
examples.english: Rather than only pointing out faults, you should also look at the other person's good qualities.

notes:
A somewhat literary word for positive qualities. Composed of {美|び} (beauty) and {点|てん} (point). More elegant and formal than everyday alternatives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美点|びてん}を{見|み}つける: to find good qualities
- {美点|びてん}に{目|め}を{向|む}ける: to turn one's attention to good points
- {最大|さいだい}の{美点|びてん}: greatest virtue
- {美点|びてん}と{欠点|けってん}: merits and faults

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {長所|ちょうしょ}: strong point — everyday, practical strengths
- {利点|りてん}: advantage — functional benefit, not about character
- {美徳|びとく}: virtue — moral excellence, stronger than {美点|びてん}
